mechanisms.finding: Reflection k_i -> 2*sum(other k_j)-k_i is an involution and preserves Q=(sum k)^2-2*sum(k_j^2) over any commutative ring.
mechanisms.argument: Write s=sum(other coordinates), a=k_i. Reflection a′=2s-a gives a′′=a and Q(a′)-Q(a)=0 by polynomial expansion. No inversion of 2 is used.
mechanisms.scope: Written algebraic derivation, no fresh Lean build by corpus track; separate noncommutativity/hardness statements retain their own hypotheses.

mechanisms.finding: Amplitude state is a 144-coordinate function; direct retrieval is exact. The named constant-time theorem has conclusion True, not an operational cost bound.
mechanisms.scope: Useful structured query representation; do not infer lossless arbitrary 144:1 compression or quantum hardware behavior.

mechanisms.finding: Exact rational numerator/denominator pairs and cross-product equivalence are reusable; div′ returns zero on a zero divisor numerator.
mechanisms.scope: A totalized convention must be explicit or replaced by certified nonzero input before reuse as ordinary field division.

mechanisms.finding: An exact quadratic-energy certificate does not by itself prove a maximum-norm bound. Retain the energy identity and require an independent stability bridge.
mechanisms.counterexample: R=[[3/5,-4/5],[4/5,3/5]], x=(1,1), R*x=(-1/5,7/5). Squared Euclidean norm remains 2 while maximum norm grows from 1 to 7/5.
mechanisms.scope: Exact rational counterexample to the implication, not a rejection of all discrete CRAM mechanisms or a rerun of the unavailable NS solver.

mechanisms.finding: Recovered leads: heterogeneous per-lane operators and exceptional-set coupling; clean-window/resonance claims; QEC and wavelet correspondences; exact skew advection; auxiliary-lane FPD error scope.
mechanisms.scope: Leads only. A scalar rho=min(moduli) is not automatically a code distance, operator spectral radius, stability constant or cryptographic entropy bound; definitions and concrete maps must be supplied.
